title: VTS-Screen: web tool, data, trained models and code for machine learning of ammonia removal and mass transfer in vacuum thermal stripping
description:
Data, trained models and analysis code supporting the manuscript From Published Experiments to a Web-Based Prediction Tool: Machine Learning of Ammonia Removal and Mass Transfer in Vacuum Thermal Stripping (Rahman, Guo, Rony, Qiu, Li).

  • index.html: the VTS-Screen browser-based prediction tool (CatBoost models embedded, runs client-side).
  • data/: compiled vacuum thermal stripping (VTS) database from six peer-reviewed studies; removal-efficiency (η) subset, n = 218, and volumetric mass-transfer coefficient (KLa) subset, n = 159; inputs T, Pv, pH, t (xlsx + csv).
  • models/: CatBoost champion models (library defaults, seed 42) refitted on the complete subsets, as deployed in the VTS-Screen web tool (.cbm and .json).
  • notebooks/: model comparison of 11 algorithms (Taylor diagrams), 10×10 repeated cross-validation with the Nadeau–Bengio corrected resampled t-test and Holm adjustment, CatBoost convergence and bootstrap plateau test, SHAP interpretation and partial-dependence surfaces.
  • results/: ranking tables, per-fold CV scores, significance tables, SHAP values and figures.

Cross-validated R² (CatBoost): 0.883 ± 0.073 (η), 0.970 ± 0.026 (KLa). Web tool: https://saiflearn0.github.io/vts-screening-tool/
